title: Asiad: Boxer Ogayre bows out of contention with loss to Uzbek foe
summary: Filipino boxer Junmilardo Ogayre is out of medal contention in the 2026 Asian Games after a lopsided loss to Uzbekistan's Abdumalik Khalokov, Sunday at the Nishio Gymnasium.
